name: Wilmington College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college affiliated with the Religious Society of Friends (Quakers); HLC accredited. Emphasizes hands-on, experiential learning with labs, greenhouses, and academic farms. Notable program areas include exercise science, sustainable/agricultural sciences, and business/finance.
financial_aid: 99% of students receive financial aid, with an average aid package of $24,263. Scholarships awarded based on academics, leadership, diversity enhancement, and talent; grants awarded as-needed. FAFSA priority deadline March 15 (FAFSA code 003142). College advertises offering more financial aid than most large public universities/colleges in Ohio. As an NCAA D3 institution, no athletic scholarships are offered.
facilities_notes: Wilmington College Quakers softball competes at the on-campus softball field. Detailed facilities specifications not published on the softball program page checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Ohio Athletic Conference (OAC). Team X/Twitter account: @DubC_Softball.
notes: Data gathered from wilmingtonquakers.com softball coaches and roster pages and wilmington.edu financial aid/tuition pages, checked 2026-07. Roster size (22) reflects the 2026 softball roster. Tuition figure is 2025-26 main campus annual undergraduate tuition ($31,654; plus a $1,450 annual student services fee). No athletic scholarships (NCAA D3).
